purpose: Teach: 仏壇/クローズアップ/パロディ/編曲/生態学/魔法使い/戯曲/ナース

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが仏壇を毎朝整えられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to tend the altar every morning.
lines.style: Soft, almost to himself. Gentle nostalgia in the opening. Slow pace, like watching a memory surface. Eyes slightly distant. Voice carries the weight of time gently, not heavily.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃんのお店、テレビでクローズアップされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — your grandfather's shop was featured on television, wasn't it, dear?
lines.style: Warm and present, meeting him in the memory. Light curiosity underneath — checking in, inviting him to continue. Slight rise at the question, as if drawing him out gently. The 'dear' lands with affection, not distance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが歌のパロディを歌われたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to sing parodies of songs.
lines.style: The same wistful tone, but lighter now. A small smile sitting in the voice. Slower still on 'parodies' — lingering on the memory of him being playful. Trailing quietness at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、好きな曲を編曲する趣味もおありだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather had a hobby of arranging his favorite songs, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Following his lead with recognition. Her tone says 'I remember this too.' Warm and collaborative, not correcting. A slight lift of affection in her voice. The question lands as acknowledgment rather than curiosity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが生態学のご本を読まれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he read books on ecology.
lines.style: Voice settles lower, more contemplative. The rhythm slightly more measured — he's honoring something quieter about this memory. Not wistful in the same way, but reverent. Breath barely present, like speaking in a library.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、孫に魔法使いのお話をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather used to tell the grandchildren wizard stories, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Her voice brightens slightly — she's leaning into the magic of it. Playful warmth underneath. Her question carries both recognition and affection. A gentle teasing note, like 'yes, I know how imaginative he was.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが戯曲の脚本も書かれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he even wrote scripts for plays.
lines.style: The final memory lands with a kind of completion. Slight emphasis on 'even' — acknowledging the depth of his creativity. Voice carries quiet pride. Warm, almost intimate tone. Trailing off gently, as if offering the memory as a gift.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ばあさんがナースのお仕事をされてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandmother — I worked as a nurse back then, didn't I, dear?
lines.style: Tender turn inward. She's offering her own place in the story, not self-consciously but with quiet dignity. Warm and inclusive, bringing herself gently into their shared past. A closing note of calm recognition. Voice softens on 'dear' — intimate, closing the circle.
